genxml.title: SGI HPC3 Ethernet DMA channels (Indy)
genxml.doc: The receive and transmit DMA channels of the HPC3 peripheral controller, which move frames between main memory and the SEEQ Ethernet controller, with the layouts of the descriptor words they read and write. Offsets are from the start of the HPC3 register window; the HPC3 of the Indy sits at physical 1fb80000. Grades say how each item was derived: established means read in the HPC3 specification, a public driver or the shipped IRIX driver as the source records; inferred means a reasoned reading, with the reasoning in docs/hpc3-ethernet.md. Registers the specification does not list are marked as such.

struct.name: RX_CBP
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, p. 33 (address map) and p. 39 (field definitions)
struct.doc: Receive current buffer pointer. HPC3 loads it when it fetches a descriptor, so it names the buffer being filled.

struct.name: RX_NBDP
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 39
struct.doc: Receive next descriptor pointer. Software writes the physical address of the first descriptor here before it sets the channel active.

struct.name: RX_BC
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 39-40
struct.doc: Receive byte count and flags of the current descriptor. The count is read only to the programmed interface; the flags are read and written.

struct.name: RX_CNTL
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 39-40
struct.doc: Receive control and status. The status bits are read only copies of the SEEQ receive status.

struct.name: RX_GIO
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 39
struct.doc: Receive FIFO tail pointer, diagnostic. Normal software does not write it.

struct.name: RX_DEV
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 39
struct.doc: Receive FIFO head pointer, diagnostic.

struct.name: ENET_RESET
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, p. 41
struct.doc: Reset and interrupt control, shared by both Ethernet channels. The specification calls it misc.

struct.name: DMACFG
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 41-42
struct.doc: DMA timing and the SEEQ work-around enables. The timing fields reset to 1111 according to the specification; the other fields have no stated reset.

struct.name: PIOCFG
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 41-42
struct.doc: PIO timing to the SEEQ. The timing fields reset to 1111 according to the specification; the other bits have no stated reset.

struct.name: TX_CBP
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, p. 34 (address map, read) and p. 43 (field text, read and write)
struct.doc: Transmit current buffer pointer. The specification gives the access as read in one place and read and write in another.

struct.name: TX_NBDP
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 43
struct.doc: Transmit next descriptor pointer. Software writes the physical address of the first descriptor here before it sets the channel active.

struct.name: TX_BC
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33, 43
struct.doc: Transmit byte count and flags of the current descriptor. The count and the end-of-chain sample bit are read only.

struct.name: TX_CNTL
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, p. 44
struct.doc: Transmit control and status. The status bits are read only copies of the SEEQ transmit status.

struct.name: TX_GIO
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 43
struct.doc: Transmit FIFO tail pointer, diagnostic.

struct.name: TX_DEV
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 33 and 43
struct.doc: Transmit FIFO head pointer, diagnostic.

struct.name: RX_CUR_DESC
struct.from: IRIX 6.5 base-release Ethernet driver object (initialisation and interrupt handler). Not in the HPC3 specification.
struct.doc: Receive current descriptor pointer. The specification does not list it. The IRIX driver writes it at initialisation with the descriptor it marks end-of-chain, and reads it after the receive channel stops. How the hardware updates it is not settled; see docs/hpc3-ethernet.md.

struct.name: TX_FIRST_CUR
struct.from: IRIX 6.5 base-release Ethernet driver object (transmit path and interrupt handler). Not in the HPC3 specification.
struct.doc: First descriptor of the packet in progress. The specification does not list it. The IRIX driver reads it. Its update rule is unknown.

struct.name: TX_FIRST_PREV
struct.from: IRIX 6.5 base-release Ethernet driver object (transmit path and interrupt handler). Not in the HPC3 specification.
struct.doc: First descriptor of the previous packet. The specification does not list it. The IRIX driver reads it while the transmit channel is active, to reclaim transmit descriptors. Its update rule is unknown.

struct.name: RX_DESC_CTL
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 6-7 and 14
struct.doc: Word 1 of a receive descriptor, the count and flags that HPC3 writes back when a frame has been stored.

struct.name: TX_DESC_CTL
struct.from: HPC3 Chip Specification, revision 1.4, pp. 6-7, 13-14
struct.doc: Word 1 of a transmit descriptor: the count, flags and inter-packet gap byte.
